title: Hank Wethington — 'broke my own three-book-a-month rule to include it'
summary: Hank Wethington — curator of the monthly '3 Stand Out Books' feature — publishes an August issue that breaks his own three-book-a-month rule to make room for Incorruptible. Highlights that corruption in business isn't a one-off event: it's baked into the system.
blockquote: I always try to keep this to three books a month, which is why it's called '3 Stand Out Books.' This month I couldn't. I tried. This is a first. Four books made the cut, and I'm not apologizing for it… Incorruptible - Eric Ries. A few things stuck with me here. Corruption in business isn't a one-off event, it's baked into the system.
attribution_title: Curator of '3 Stand Out Books' monthly reading feature
